bullet: Nothing to resume after the end (`F11.goal-resume-finished`).
script:
NG=$(control-agent-server conversation events "$G" --key goal | jq -e .matching)
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$X/goal/resume" --expect 400 --check detail eq no_resumable_goal --save F11.goal-resume-finished/capped
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$G/goal/resume" --expect 400 --check detail eq no_resumable_goal --save F11.goal-resume-finished/complete
control-agent-server conversation events "$X" --key goal --expect-count 3
control-agent-server conversation events "$G" --key goal | jq -e ".matching == $NG"
